[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name = Twin Serpent Lakes | game link type 0 = explorable | game link num 0 = 061 }} The name of this area is derived from its two large lakes—one in the north, the other in the south. These lakes resemble the heads of serpents (or footprints to some observers). Together with the winding natural passes between the northern and southern halves, they give the impression of two serpents intertwined. The lakes' waters and the streams that feed them make this a bountiful hunting ground; many different creatures call this place home, including the [[Caromi]] [[Tengu]]. == Shrines == ;[[Resurrection
